_doc: Księży Młyn (Łódź) tree roster — maps the census species (assigned from the Łódź palette in scratch/lodz-tree-census.mjs, split by the Drzewa_LIDAR conifer/deciduous flag) → CURRENT roster/library species_ids. Most Łódź species reuse LS's authored compositions 1:1 (linden→linden_american, klon/Norway maple→maple_sugar, dąb/English oak→oak_white+oak_bur, platan→platanus_acerifolia, brzoza→birch). Conifers (świerk/spruce, żywotnik/thuja, modrzew/larch) → procedural_conifer. Empty match → the category picker fills via park_trees.shape (broad/conifer). Operator-edit by hand in the Salon.

_new_species_suggestions._doc: Species genuinely present in Łódź that LS never authored a composition for. Fallback routes them to generic_tree_2 today so the grove NEVER blanks; these are the chassis/part suggestions to author a proper composition in the Salon and replace the fallback.

Horse Chestnut.silhouette: large dense DOME / broad rounded crown, low branching
Horse Chestnut.chassis: a broad low-domed deciduous chassis (widest habit in _chassis/); avoid columnar/vase
Horse Chestnut.leaf: palmate_compound (5-7 leaflets radiating) — a coverage gap in the leaf packs; nearest existing: broad simple as placeholder
Horse Chestnut.season: candle-white spring bloom (skip for v1); yellow-brown early fall

Black Locust.silhouette: OPEN, airy, irregular upright crown — see-through, not dense
Black Locust.chassis: an open/sparse-canopy deciduous chassis; low leaf-density variant
Black Locust.leaf: fine_compound (pinnate, many small oval leaflets) — coverage gap; nearest: fine simple
Black Locust.season: white pea-flower racemes late spring (skip v1); pale-yellow fall

Spruce / Thuja / Larch.botanical: Picea abies / Thuja occidentalis / Larix decidua (świerk / żywotnik / modrzew)
Spruce / Thuja / Larch.note: LS's grove is all-deciduous, so there is no authored conifer composition. procedural_conifer renders them today; a real conifer chassis + short_needle leaf (both coverage gaps) would upgrade the 862 conifers.
